title: Programmable design of functional proteins from natural language
title_zh: 基于自然语言的功能蛋白可程序化设计
abstract: Programming biological function—designing bespoke proteins to perform specified molecular tasks—is a foundational goal of molecular engineering. However, current design models remain fundamentally limited1–3: they typically require either natural proteins as starting points for optimization or manual reformulation of functional goals as geometric and sequence-level constraints to guide candidate generation. Here we introduce Pinal, a 16-billion-parameter foundation model that designs candidate proteins from natural-language descriptions of desired function. Trained on 1.7 billion synthetically annotated protein–text pairs, Pinal links functional intent to protein sequence and structure. In computational evaluations, generated candidates combined high predicted foldability with functional-description alignment and sequence diversity, providing a basis for prioritizing experimentally testable designs. We applied Pinal to four distinct design tasks—a fluorescent protein, a polyethylene terephthalate hydrolase, an alcohol dehydrogenase and a metabolic H-protein—and experimentally observed the intended function in each case, including catalytic activity for both designed enzymes. Without iterative experimental optimization, a Pinal-designed H-protein increased product titre by 1.7-fold relative to the corresponding native Escherichia coli H-protein in a multi-enzyme CO2 fixation pathway. These findings support natural language as a high-level interface for candidate generation in protein design, enabling programmable exploration with reduced reliance on manually specified structural or sequence constraints. Pinal, a 16-billion-parameter artificial intelligence model, designs functional proteins from natural-language descriptions, demonstrating experimentally validated activities and improved CO2-fixation product yields without iterative optimization.
abstract_zh: 对生物功能进行编程——设计定制蛋白以执行指定的分子任务——是分子工程的基础目标之一。然而，现有设计模型根本上仍受到限制1–3：它们通常需要以天然蛋白作为优化起点，或者需要将功能目标手动重新表述为几何和序列层面的约束，以指导候选物生成。在此，我们引入了 Pinal，这是一种具有160亿个参数的基础模型，能够根据期望功能的自然语言描述设计候选蛋白。Pinal在17亿个合成标注的蛋白-文本对上训练，将功能意图与蛋白质序列和结构相关联。在计算评估中，生成的候选物结合了高预测可折叠性、与功能描述的一致性以及序列多样性，为优先选择可验证的实验设计提供了依据。我们将 Pinal 应用于四个不同的设计任务——一种荧光蛋白、一种对位苯二甲酸乙二醇酯水解酶、一种酒精脱氢酶和一种代谢 H-蛋白——并在每种情况下实验观察到了预期功能，包括两种设计酶的催化活性。在无需迭代实验优化的情况下，由 Pinal 设计的 H-蛋白使多酶 CO2 固定途径中的产物滴定相对于相应的本源大肠杆菌 H-蛋白提高了 1.7 倍。这些发现支持自然语言作为蛋白质设计候选生成的高层接口，使可程序化探索成为可能，并减少了对手动指定的结构或序列约束的依赖。 Pinal 是一种具有 160 亿参数的人工智能模型，能够从自然语言描述中设计功能蛋白，展示了经实验验证的活性和改善的 CO2 固定产物产量，且无需迭代优化。
